title: Dimension of a rotated linear graph plane
statement: For all natural numbers n, l, every linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l) and every continuous linear map A : R^n -> R^l, the subspace S = span_R{q(graphPoint v (A v)) : v in R^n} of R^(n+l) has dimension n, i.e. Module.finrank R S = n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => q (graphPoint v (A v)))) = n
